name: Exp_MultiTrend_Signal_KVN
summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom MultiTrend_Signal_KVN indicator, which identifies trend direction changes. It opens positions only when the signal indicates a trend reversal from the opposite direction, and closes existing positions when the trend signal flips. Position sizing is controlled via a deposit share or fixed lot input parameter.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义MultiTrend_Signal_KVN指标的交易信号进行操作，识别趋势方向变化。仅在信号表明从相反方向发生趋势反转时才开仓，并在趋势信号翻转时平仓。仓位大小通过存款份额或固定手数输入参数控制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于MultiTrend_Signal_KVN指标的趋势跟踪交易系统。入场条件为：当指标在SignalBar上产生买入信号且上一趋势为下跌趋势时开多仓，当产生卖出信号且上一趋势为上涨趋势时开空仓，确保只在趋势反转时入场。出场条件包括：止损和止盈分别设为1000点和2000点，同时当反向信号出现时主动平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。策略还通过向后搜索历史K线确定最近趋势方向，作为入场过滤条件，只有趋势反转信号才会触发开仓。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following trading system based on the custom MultiTrend_Signal_KVN indicator. Entry conditions require a buy signal on the SignalBar when the last detected trend was bearish, or a sell signal when the last trend was bullish, ensuring positions are opened only on trend reversals. Exit conditions include a Stop Loss of 1000 points, a Take Profit of 2000 points, and active position closing when an opposing signal appears. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit calculated proportionally. The EA uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation occurs only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades on the same bar. The strategy also performs a backward search through historical bars to determine the last trend direction, serving as an entry filter that only permits trades on confirmed trend reversals.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款份额或固定手数，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management: lot size or margin ratio

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 趋势反转确认机制：只在确认趋势反转时才开仓，减少假信号导致的亏损交易
完善的新K线检测机制：使用IsNewBar确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓
灵活的仓位管理：支持固定手数和按存款比例两种模式，适应不同资金规模
买卖方向独立控制：可分别启用或禁用买入和卖出方向，便于单向交易或对冲策略
pros_en: Trend reversal confirmation mechanism: positions are only opened when a confirmed trend reversal occurs, reducing losses from false signals
Robust new bar detection: the IsNewBar mechanism ensures signal calculation happens only once per bar, preventing duplicate entries
Flexible position sizing: supports both fixed lot size and deposit share modes, accommodating different account sizes
Independent buy/sell direction control: buy and sell directions can be enabled or disabled separately, useful for directional bias or hedging strategies
cons: 依赖自定义指标：MultiTrend_Signal_KVN指标不在代码中，无法审查其核心逻辑和可靠性
止损止盈比例偏低：止损1000点对比止盈2000点，盈亏比2:1虽合理但点数偏大，可能不适于所有品种
缺乏点差过滤：没有检查当前点差是否过大，在点差较大时可能以不利价格成交
回溯搜索趋势效率低：向后遍历所有K线搜索最近趋势方向，在历史数据量大时可能影响性能
cons_en: Dependency on custom indicator: the MultiTrend_Signal_KVN indicator code is not included, making it impossible to audit the core logic and reliability
Large SL/TP point values: Stop Loss of 1000 points and Take Profit of 2000 points may not be suitable for all instruments or brokers with different point definitions
No spread filter: the EA does not check whether the current spread is too wide, potentially leading to unfavorable fills during high-spread conditions
Inefficient trend search: the backward bar iteration to find the last trend direction could be slow with large historical data, though mitigated by new-bar-only execution
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，在点差超过阈值时暂停交易，避免不利成交价格
加入持仓检查和重复开仓防护，确保不会在同一信号上重复开仓
优化趋势回溯搜索算法，设置最大搜索K线数限制，避免极端情况下的性能问题
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to pause trading when the spread exceeds a configurable threshold, preventing unfavorable fills
Add position checking and duplicate entry protection to ensure the EA does not open multiple positions on the same signal
Optimize the backward trend search algorithm by adding a maximum lookback bar limit to prevent performance issues in extreme cases

risk_points: 核心指标逻辑不可审查，信号可靠性无法验证
没有点差过滤，高波动时段可能以较大滑点成交
Recount机制在CopyBuffer失败时会反复重试，可能在数据异常时导致频繁计算
risk_points_en: Core indicator logic is unauditable, making signal reliability unverifiable
No spread filter means potentially large slippage during high-volatility periods
The Recount mechanism repeatedly retries on CopyBuffer failures, which could cause frequent recalculation during data anomalies
